author: Pallas, 1811
summary: 참새만 한 크기로 바다오리류 가운데 가장 작다. 암벽이 있는 해안에 무리 지어 살다가 알을 낳으러 땅으로 내려온다. 물 위에서 잠수해 물속 무척추동물을 떠내듯 잡아먹는다. 바위 벽의 좁고 깊은 틈에 알을 1개 낳으며, 한 달이 안 되어 깬 새끼를 한 달 동안 기르고, 알래스카 해안에 분포한다.

points.en: dark red bill and yellow eye
dark brown to black back and wings

art.subject: Least Auklet (Aethia pusilla), adult in winter (non-breeding) plumage, as seen on the sea off the Korean east coast in winter: crown, nape, back and wings blackish; a white line along the scapulars; throat, foreneck and underparts white, with a little dusky smudging on the sides; no facial plumes; tiny stubby blackish bill; whitish iris; grey webbed feet hidden under the water.
art.pose: swimming on the sea surface, side view
art.scene: winter sea off the Korean east coast, grey-blue choppy water near a rocky shore; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding (summer), side view standing upright on a rock: blackish upperparts, white throat, white underparts mottled with dark spots, fine white plumes behind the eye, tiny dark red bill with a pale tip, whitish eye, grey webbed feet, very short tail
adult winter, side view swimming: blackish crown and back with a white scapular line, clean white throat and underparts, tiny blackish bill, whitish eye
art.build: Tiny, rotund auk, about 15cm, sparrow-sized and the smallest auk, with a round head, no visible neck and a very short tail. Bill tiny and stubby, much shorter than the head. Legs set far back, with grey webbed feet. Wings short and narrow, beaten in a fast whirring flight low over the sea. Swims buoyantly and dives often.
avoid: Do not paint a large or brightly coloured bill or a curled forehead crest; those suit Crested or Rhinoceros Auklet.
Do not paint a black throat and grey back; that is Ancient Murrelet (Synthliboramphus antiquus), common off Korea in winter.
Do not show the red bill and white facial plumes on the winter bird; they are breeding features.
Do not paint a yellow iris.
